# Velair 1.9.0-beta.3

This beta adds optional master-dependent Preconditioning, immediate Away mode for one-off returns, and clearer explanations of learning and climate delivery.

## ✨ Added

- Set a **Preconditioning master** when a room depends on heating or cooling equipment scheduled by another Velair climate. Dependent preparation starts at the later of its own estimate and the selected master's preparation, keeping the room's own target temperature and deadline. Independent remains the default. The relationship, effective start and known blocking reasons appear in cards and Diagnostics. Based on the [community discussion](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/velair-local-first-climate-scheduling-for-home-assistant-climates/1015394/66).
- One-off returns can **Apply Away mode now**, even while someone is still home. Presence can trigger the return only after all configured sources have remained absent for the saved confirmation delay. Short exits and unknown readings restart that wait. Scheduled arrival, preparation and explicit cancellation remain available; leaving the option unchecked preserves existing behavior.
- Automations can use `velair.pause_zone` with `until_next_block: true` to pause a room until its next scheduled block, including with a custom `pause_id`. Thanks to **@intru91** for [issue #45](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/45).

## 🔄 Changed

- **Planned return** has its own sidebar tab beside Preconditioning, with its existing labels, an introduction and contextual help. Existing shortcuts open the appropriate tab and retain protection for unsaved settings.
- Portable exports use model version **19** to include Preconditioning master relationships. Existing backups remain importable; older Velair versions cannot import model 19 exports. Keep an earlier backup before testing a downgrade.

## 🚀 Improved

- Learning shows a short contextual explanation per heating/cooling direction when evidence is available, with a direct link to the room's Preconditioning history in Diagnostics. Expandable details distinguish active observation, skipped transitions, interruptions and complete, partial or invalid results without repeating counters or predictions.
- Diagnostics explains command-settling mismatches with the values Velair expected and those reported by the climate, without requiring a downloaded report.
- Overview, return cards and return settings distinguish preparation from waiting for departure and confirming absence, with shared contextual help and fewer repeated messages.
- The Live prediction indicator has compact, balanced spacing for heating and cooling. Master settings remain collapsed by default, showing the selected value with help beside the title and guidance for systems that need this relationship.
- On phones up to 480 px wide, information popups open beside their trigger, above or below as space permits, and stay within the visible area with internal scrolling for long explanations. Tablet and desktop positioning is unchanged.
- Updated interface and Home Assistant action translations in all nine maintained non-English languages, and refreshed 36 guides covering Preconditioning, Diagnostics, Planned Return and general usage. Master help opens the translated guide and its timing examples.

## 🧭 Notes

- This beta follows [1.9.0-beta.2](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.0-beta.2). Existing independent Preconditioning and unchecked one-off return requests retain their behavior.
- A master relationship coordinates Velair's scheduled actions. It does not control the boiler directly or confirm its relay state, heat supply or cooling supply. A master without suitable preparation leaves the dependent room at its normal block; self-links, chains and cycles are rejected.
- Learning history remains in memory, follows the existing retention settings and is cleared on restart. Stored learning samples retain their existing persistence. Explanations do not infer boiler operation or equipment faults from an unchanged temperature.
- A pause until the next block keeps its original expiry if the schedule is edited later. It cannot be combined with `duration_minutes`; requests without a future block are rejected.
- Live Home Assistant themes, physical devices and Companion app behavior still need real-world validation. The desktop card-picker report in [issue #43](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/43) is not claimed fixed.
- Documentation translations are AI-assisted and have not received qualified human linguistic review. Please report wording or terminology issues.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app. If the previous interface remains visible, perform a hard refresh or clear the site cache.
